title: Microelectrode recordings (MER) from deep brain stimulation surgery in Parkinson's disease (STN targeting, 14 patients)
description: Intraoperative microelectrode recordings (MER) from 14 patients with Parkinson's disease undergoing stereotactic deep brain stimulation (DBS) surgery targeting the subthalamic nucleus. Each file covers one recording depth with up to three channels, and depths are classified as inside (STN-IN) or outside (STN-OUT) the nucleus by neurophysiologists and surgeons. The data are an unfiltered, lossless iEEG-BIDS re-packaging of the authors' Zenodo release.
methods_description: Recordings were acquired during DBS surgery with up to three microelectrode channels per depth file and no filtering or processing applied. Sampling rate was about 12 kHz, computed per run from the release time vector. The original MATLAB int16 arrays were converted losslessly to BrainVision float32 with BIDS sidecars.
